description: The plot titled “ChatGPT on Movies” illustrates how three reported metrics (accuracy, confidence, and alignment) vary as question popularity changes. The x-axis is labeled “Question Popularity,” shown on a linear scale spanning roughly 15 to 55, with numeric ticks at regular 5-unit intervals (15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55). The y-axis is labeled “Values,” shown on a linear scale from 0.86 to 1.00, with regularly spaced tick labels every 0.02. Three solid lines with markers are displayed: the Accuracy series is a blue solid line with circular markers, starting near 0.895 at popularity 15, rising to about 0.922 at 16, dipping to around 0.901 at 17, then increasing through approximately 0.933 (20), 0.962 (22), 0.960 (24), 0.965 (27), 0.972 (31), 0.982 (38), and ending near 0.986 at 55. The Confidence series is a green solid line with upward triangle markers, beginning around 0.977 at 15, staying near 0.978–0.980 across 16–18, increasing to about 0.988 at 20, then hovering close to 0.990–0.992 from 22 to 27, reaching roughly 0.995 at 31, showing about 0.994 at 38, and ending near 0.997 at 55. The Alignment series is a red solid line with square markers, starting around 0.919 at 15, increasing to about 0.942 at 16, dropping to roughly 0.922 at 17, rising again to about 0.943 at 20, then moving through approximately 0.973 (22), 0.969 (24), 0.973 (27), 0.976 (31), 0.987 (38), and finishing near 0.990 at 55.
